title: Conversational Action Queue 1.1
description: Persisted at mission_dir/action_queue.json by tools/hokage_orchestrator/skill_runtime.py's ActionQueue. New artifact type - there is no 1.0.0 predecessor schema. Each entry in 'actions' is validated against the sibling conversational_action_proposal.v2.schema.json file in this same directory via a local, relative $ref - resolved offline, no network or external registry involved.
